title: receiptSharing=false interaction with burnOnRead unspecified
description: burnOnRead hard-deletes the recipient copy immediately after readAt is set. When the recipient has receiptSharing=false, the outbound Peer/receipt carrying readAt is suppressed. The sender never learns the message was read and cannot verify the burn occurred. The spec does not address whether receiptSharing=false suppresses the burnOnRead signal to the sender. This should be explicitly stated.
close_reason: Fixed: burnOnRead now documents interaction with receiptSharing=false (chat-00.md:512)
